flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminapi workflows/enforcement (EnforcementController /v1/enforcement-report and /enforcement-report/export, EnforcementServiceImpl: VON + audit query, Excel workbook), auth api-authorization.properties [OCMS_REPORT_NOTICE_FE]. ocmsadminui pages/Report (lists/ReportList, lists/ReportListNoticeFE, component/ReportSlot, index), utils/mapping/Report/MapReportNoticeFE. ocmsadminprivateapi: cron-schedules-prod.properties (no notice report cron). ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not relevant to this story
note: Status in the sheet: 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'; demo remark: focus is on the report from notices sent through the REPCCS webhook, not on the integration. There is no OCMS flow deck, so 'Sesuai' means the code does what the story text says. What exists is the on-demand 'Notices Created by Enforcement Systems' report on the staff portal Report page: source and date filters, Excel export with a Summary, Success and Error sheets per offence type, and notice details. What does not exist: automatic daily generation (no cron or job) and routing to an OIC dashboard (only the generic Report menu). The Summary has a tally gap for REPCCS rejections with an empty offence type. Maintenance tickets: OCMS-DF-2026-005 (summary not tallying for CES, Closed/Prod deployed) and OCMS-DF-2026-149 (export moved to the backend, Closed/Prod deployed); both are in the code on main and do not lower a fit by themselves, but the empty-offence-type gap in the Summary step remains. Not provable from the repo: which role gets the function OCMS_REPORT_NOTICE_FE, the standard code content behind the source dropdown, and the export result in each environment.
recommendation: Claim partially: the on-demand Excel report exists and works, but automatic daily generation and routing to an OIC dashboard do not exist. Confirm with URA whether the manual report in the Report menu is accepted as enough. Fix the Total vs Failed tally for REPCCS rejections with an empty offence type.

steps.step: Notices received from REPCCS and EHT/CES are kept in OCMS so they can be reported (successful notices in VON, failed receipts in the audit transaction table)
steps.detail: getEnforcementReport reads successful notices from VON by creDate and subsystem label (findEnforcementReport, EnforcementServiceImpl.java:325-327; status 0, :454-481) and failed receipts from ocms_web_txn_audit and eocms_web_txn_audit with status 1 (:340-360, 366-390), filtered by sender CES or REP. These are the same sources the receipt paths of OCMS3.1 and OCMS3.2 write. The limitation for REPCCS rejections inside createNotice that are not marked failed is recorded in OCMS3.1.

steps.step: The OIC can run the report for one day or a chosen date range, per source (REPCCS or EHT/CES)
steps.detail: The 'Notices Created by Enforcement Systems' Report screen has a source dropdown, a date range (default from the start of yesterday until now, ReportListNoticeFE.tsx:50-53) and Search/Export buttons. Source REPCCS maps to sender REP (prefix match, covering REPCCS_ENC and REPCCS_EHT, plus MEV_Vehicle) and source CES maps to sender CES (MapReportNoticeFE.ts:15-22, EnforcementServiceImpl.java:277-306); the dropdown hides REPCCS_ENC and shows REPCCS_EHT as REPCCS (ReportSlot.tsx:104-113). Export only works for the REPCCS or CES source (ReportListNoticeFE.tsx:71). The standard code table content behind the dropdown: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The report is generated automatically every day (daily) without anyone running it by hand
steps.detail: The daily report cron in ocmsadminprivateapi only contains Payment Exception, Daily Paid, RIP Hirer/Driver, HST, Unclaimed Batch Data, Furnish Daily Officer Notification and Classified Vehicle (cron-schedules-prod.properties:258-268). No cron, @Scheduled or other job builds the enforcement-system notice report (ocmsadminapi has no @Scheduled). The report is only built when a user presses Export (EnforcementController.java:36-38). Synonyms searched in both layers: enforcement, notice created, summary report, frontend enforcement, REPCCS/CES report.

steps.step: The report holds a summary: total received, total successful, total failed, and a sheet per offence type
steps.detail: The workbook has a Summary sheet with generation date and time, date range, Total Records Received, Total Successful and Total Failed (EnforcementServiceImpl.java:141-147), then Success_{O,E,U,A,T}_Offence and Error_{O,E,U,A,T}_Offence sheets (:149-160). Total comes from data.size() (:126), but successful and failed only count rows whose offence type is O/E/U/A/T; other rows are skipped (:118). For failed rows from the REP source the offence type is looked up from the rule code (:575) with no default; the default 'O' exists only in the CES branch (:555-558). A rejection for an invalid offence code (a common failure reason, RepWebHookPayloadValidator.java:447-476) therefore has an empty offence type: it counts in Total but is in no Error sheet and not in Total Failed, so Total does not equal Successful + Failed. This is the same symptom as OCMS-DF-2026-005 (summary not tallying, Closed/Prod deployed); the backend fix OCMS-DF-2026-149 (Closed/Prod deployed) is in the code but this gap remains. The per-day summary the story asks for is not split by day: one figure covers the whole date range.

steps.step: The report lists the details of each notice received (notice no, offence type, vehicle, offence time, rule code, car park, amount, transaction ID, ANS flag)
steps.detail: REPCCS header: S/N, Source, Notice No., Offence Type, ANS Flag, Transaction ID, Date/Time Received, Vehicle No., Offence Date/Time, Computer Rule Code, PP Code, Composition Amount, Vehicle Category, Vehicle Registration Type, Operator/PW ID, Subsystem Label, OBU Label. The EHT/CES header replaces the last three columns with EHT ID, PO ID and IU NUMBER (EnforcementServiceImpl.java:81-92). writeEnforcementSheet fills rows to match those headers (:166-205) from VON and audit data (:454-481). The column set was not checked against what the OIC expects (the story gives no column specification).

steps.step: The report is routed to the OIC's dashboard (available in the staff portal Report menu for users with access)
steps.detail: The report appears as the 'Notices Created by Enforcement Systems' tab on the staff portal Report page when the user has the function OCMS_REPORT_NOTICE_FE (ReportList.tsx:50-57, constant.ts:253, index.tsx:21-24). The server maps that function to the related endpoints (api-authorization.properties:118-121). There is no OIC dashboard concept and no push, notification or email routing the report to the OIC; the OIC must open the menu and run it. Which role is given that function (whether the OIC): cannot verify from repo, it is configuration data. The Report page is the generic mechanism for every report, not the OIC dashboard the story names.

steps.step: The OIC can download the report as an Excel file to see the details of the notices received
steps.detail: POST /v1/enforcement-report/export builds an .xlsx with Apache POI for all rows without pagination (EnforcementServiceImpl.java:95-103) and sends it as the attachment ReportNoticeREPCCS.xlsx or ReportNoticeEHT.xlsx (EnforcementController.java:36-58). The UI calls it and saves the file with saveAs (ReportListNoticeFE.tsx:60-85). Before OCMS-DF-2026-149 (Closed, Prod deployed) the file was built in the browser; now it is built in the backend. The download capability itself works; the downloaded result in each environment: cannot verify from repo.
